reason: Commit d350fca closes stethoscope-reports-an-ordinary-corpse: the live sighted ordinary path traverses nexthere piles, excludes REVIVE_MON, prints singular/plural source grammar, and preserves free/costly results, while exceptional dead-object siblings remain pre-effect refusals. Two fresh cases match 6,093 PRNG calls and 84 screens/cursors exactly; the independent checkpoint at b7bfeed passes 4,409 tests with development unchanged.

boundary.startingEvent: The hero applies a stethoscope and answers the direction prompt with an adjacent square: js/cmd.js dispatches `a` to doapply(), which reaches use_stethoscope() past confdir().
boundary.endingEvent: For a reachable ordinary corpse, its_dead() prints C's death determination with singular or plural grammar and use_stethoscope() returns its free-or-costly result. For every excluded adjacent target, the observable remains an atomic named refusal before shared state, output, map, or PRNG effects.
boundary.validInputs: A sighted, non-hallucinating hero points at a reachable square whose ordered pile contains one or more corpses, no statue, and no corpse with a REVIVE_MON timer. The fresh source-real setup is debug Healer seed 9240001 at 20340102030405, wishing and dropping a small-mimic corpse before listening back at it.
boundary.observables: Exact death message and grammar; pile order and corpse count; timer inspection; stethoscope_seq, gb.bhitpos and gn.notonhead; return/turn cost; complete screens, attributes and cursors; and unchanged PRNG order. Excluded variants must remain retry-atomic.
boundary.exclusions: Blind and hallucinating corpse listens; any REVIVE_MON corpse; mixed corpse/statue and statue-only piles; the out-of-reach tiny-statue walk; the Healer revival loop; and off-map output remain unported and must stop before effects. Secret terrain and monster/status branches are complete; later-turn restrap and unrelated audit deferrals have different live consumers.

sourceReview: The goal-wide trace remains recorded in the entries above. For the completed ordinary-corpse slice, apply.c its_dead() 203-220 and 256-279, its use_stethoscope() consumer at 467-469, invent.c nxtobj() 1477-1491, and timeout.c obj_has_timer() were traced in full. Commit d350fca preserves nexthere ordering, corpse counting, timer exclusion, singular/plural grammar, and return semantics. Focused tests separate nobj from nexthere and pin every excluded sibling's precedence and retry atomicity; fresh singular and two-corpse cases match complete C screens, attributes, cursors, and PRNG logs.
